faqs.a:
The city council may appoint an associate judge who shall be a resident of the city
               and be supervised in day-to-day matters concerning municipal court by the presiding
               judge. The associate judge shall be compensated pursuant to an employment agreement
               and shall report to the city council as directed from time-to-time.
(Code 1981, § 18-42; Ord. No. 3676, § 1, 1-22-2001)
